description: This file implements a logging system for the Notesnook project, including database schema, migration, log writing, and retrieval functionalities, with integration to external logging libraries.

classes.name: NNLogsMigrationProvider
classes.description: Provides database migration scripts for log storage schema.

classes.name: DatabaseLogReporter
classes.description: Handles logging messages and writes them to the database.

classes.name: DatabaseLogWriter
classes.description: Queues log messages and periodically writes them to the database, also handles log rotation.

classes.name: DatabaseLogManager
classes.description: Manages retrieval, deletion, and cleanup of logs stored in the database.

methods.name: getMigrations
methods.description: Returns migration scripts for creating the logs table and index.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a log message to the database via the reporter.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a log message to the internal queue with a timestamped date.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Inserts queued log messages into the database in chunks.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves logs grouped by date, sorted in reverse chronological order.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes all logs from the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes logs for a specific date.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the logging system with database setup and log reporters.
